alternatives.name: Agilent
alternatives.text: AgilentObserved customer-source evidence Why customers choose itPublic competitor positioning and review/forum source mapping repeatedly make Agilent a comparison point for routine LC reliability and usability. Segment and buying situationPharmaAgilent is a benchmark competitor for reliability, familiar workflows, and lab-standard LC adoption Primary objection to switchingReliability is an observed decision criterion; a direct switching objection is not established. Waters responseDifferentiate on reducing workflow risk across method transfer, reliable routine execution, compliant operation, and data review rather than asserting specification leadership alone. Agilent response: For the selected workflow, adapt the governing workflow position to the observed Agilent emphasis; do not assert advantage until target-compatible proof and approval are established. Approval not established. Required proofDirect Agilent win/loss evidence plus a controlled workflow comparison against the buying criterion are still required. Evidence confidenceMedium · 66/100 Public customer-language records surface criteria and objections but do not establish market prevalence or win/loss causality. EV-99D199FD · Observed customer evidenceReddit discussion: New HPLC system for routine workOpen canonical evidence and caveats →EV-1612B5FE · Expected — not confirmedTIDES Europe competitor evidenceOpen canonical evidence and caveats →
